recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-31776 unless future review finds generated publication artifacts out of sync with these authoritative sources.
issue_request: FHIR-31776 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request resolved as Persuasive for R5. It objected that MedicinalProductDefinition is not the subject of AdministrableProductDefinition or PackagedProductDefinition in the usual FHIR sense, requesting APD.subject be renamed to formOf; the final resolution also renamed PPD.subject to packageFor.
initial_application: The rename was applied before this reconciliation. Git history shows FHIR#31776 commits that changed AdministrableProductDefinition.subject to AdministrableProductDefinition.formOf in the resource definition, search parameter, and examples, then changed PackagedProductDefinition.subject to PackagedProductDefinition.packageFor in the resource definition, search parameter, and examples. A later FHIR#31776/FHIR#31778 commit refined the formOf wording and constraint.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps AdministrableProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, and MedicinalProductDefinition in the current build. Current source defines AdministrableProductDefinition.formOf and PackagedProductDefinition.packageFor, current search parameters use form-of and package-for, examples use packageFor/formOf, and no stale APD/PPD old relationship paths remain. Later FHIR-31863 reconciliation fixed stale narrative productFor wording to packageFor, so the neighboring resource-boundary guidance now matches this rename as well. Zulip and Confluence searches for the issue key and relationship terms found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification already reflects the approved APD.subject -> formOf and PPD.subject -> packageFor rename across the active conformance sources and examples.
